test_main: test the main function to evaluate a trained XCiT detection model on a dataset
run_parse_args: run parse_args to parse CLI arguments for testing and evaluating a detection model
test_single_gpu_test: test single_gpu_test to run inference on a single GPU with optional result visualization
test_multi_gpu_test: test multi_gpu_test to run distributed inference across multiple GPUs
test_build_detector: test build_detector to construct an XCiT-based object detection model from config
